recipe.title: serrano & corn salsa
recipe.description: This recipe started as an idea for a salad. My salad “testing” often happens during lunch – I experiment with…
ingredients: ¼ cup chopped red bell pepper
instructions: Slice corn kernels off the cob. Next, using the back of your knife, scrape the cob to get some of the leftover corn pulp. (about 1 tablespoon per cob).
Mix everything together. Let chill in the fridge for 20 minutes or up to a day. Taste and adjust seasonings. This is great served with chips, on tacos, on salads, or on grilled fish.
